notes.title: DevLog #9: 0.11 Quality of Life Update!
notes.content:
Hey Sudoku solvers! We're back with version 0.11.0 - a quality-of-life focused update that's all about polish and player experience as we gear up for our big 1.0 launch!

This might not be as feature-packed as our huge 0.10.0 release, but we've packed in some solid improvements and one massive addition that completionists are going to absolutely love!

What's New in 0.11.0

New Features & Quality of Life Improvements

 Achievement System Expansion - We've tripled our achievement count from 9 to over 30! Every solving technique family now has its own achievements, from beginner-friendly Naked Singles all the way up to mind-bending advanced patterns like ALS Chains and Sue De Coq. Whether you're earning "Captain Obvious" for your first Naked Single or becoming a "Shadow Master" after finding 10 Sue De Coqs, there's always another badge to chase!
 Massive Puzzle Library Expansion - Added 2000 brand new puzzles to our collection! More variety, more challenges, and more fun await you
 Profile Rename - Finally! You can now rename your profiles
 Better Analyze Experience - We've rewritten technique explanations to be clearer and more helpful when you're studying puzzles
 Skill System Enhancement - Increased starting magic points and reduced magic costs for many skills, allowing you to use helpful techniques more frequently during gameplay


Bug Squashing

 Fixed the XYZ-Wing skill not detecting hints properly during gameplay
 Fixed an issue where you couldn't start a new game from certain puzzle details in match history
 Fixed brush tools displaying technical names instead of proper localized text in Paint screen (no more seeing "BgColor" when it should say "Background Color")
 Fixed XY-Wing visualization showing up as a chain instead of the proper wing pattern in Analyze screen
 Fixed Sue De Coq technique not displaying purple candidates in Analyze screen
 Fixed wrong dialog title text when creating elements without groups in the drawing interface


Achievement Spotlight

Here are some of our favorite new achievements that'll put your skills to the test:

 "Sherlock Holmes" - Found 10 Hidden Sets without hints. Elementary, my dear Watson!
 "Master Angler" - Found 10 advanced patterns without hints. You've got quite the tackle box!
 "Flower Power" - Found an ALS Blossom without hints. Peace, love, and logic!
 "Ninja Warrior" - Found a Sue De Coq without hints. Effective!


Looking Ahead

We're in the home stretch for our 1.0 release! Our focus is now on squashing the last few bugs, and putting every game feature through rigorous testing. The big 1.0 launch is closer than ever!

Thanks for sticking with us on this journey. Keep those pencils sharp and those logic skills sharper - we'll see you in the next update!

notes.title: DevLog #8: The HUGE Update Before 1.0!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I haven't updated the game in 18 months, but I haven't abandoned it – in fact, I've been working hard on it this entire time! I just want it to be perfect, which is why it's taken so long.

This version, 0.10.0, is our biggest update yet. I've added a ton of new features!

Most importantly, this represents the complete feature set for our 1.0 release! That's right—we're targeting a version 1.0 launch this October. Moving forward, we'll be focusing entirely on thorough testing and bug fixes to deliver a polished, seamless experience.

The Play Screen

First up, an innovative feature that only exists in Rated Sudoku: the ability to select a cell and apply a technique family (e.g., apply the Hidden Set technique family to cell A3) based on the technique you've discovered. With this feature, you can play Sudoku faster than ever!

I've added a Hint feature – now if you're stuck, you can get a hint to help you progress.

I've also added Undo/Redo functionality, so you can now undo your recent moves. This helps you recover from mistakes quickly.

The Analyze Screen

A completely new screen to help you analyze puzzles and learn solving techniques! Our analyze feature supports the following technique families:


 Naked Sets (Naked Singles, Pairs, Triples, etc.)
 Hidden Sets (Hidden Singles, Pairs, Triples, etc.)
 Fish Patterns (X-Wing, Swordfish, Jellyfish, Finned Fish, Mutant Fish etc.)
 XYZ-Wing Family (XY-Wing, XYZ-Wing, etc.)
 Unique Loops (Types 1-4, Type 6, Hidden Unique Loops)
 BUG Patterns (Bivalue Universal Grave - Types 1-4)
 Chain Techniques (X-Chains, XY-Chains, Remote Pairs, Turbot Fish, AIC)
 ALS Chains (Almost Locked Set Chains and Loops)
 ALS Blossom (Almost Locked Set Blossom patterns)
 Sue de Coq


The Paint Screen
Create Sudoku images with our paint tool! Edit and paint a Sudoku board, draw links, rectangles, text, and more with ease. Show others your solving logic through visual diagrams!

Generate Puzzles
We've now added the ability to generate puzzles, giving you an infinite number of puzzles to play!

notes.title: DevLog 7 Major Update Delayed to 2025
notes.content:
The next major update is mostly the same as described in the last Dev Log, mostly it'll have 3 new features:


 Analyze Feature, which is a step-by-step explanation of techniques and methods used to solve a puzzle, similar to Hodoku or Sudoku Explainer
 Campaign Feature, which is basically Sudoku lessons, using text and pictures and exercises to help beginners learn Sudoku techniques and methods, and is planned to support Steam Workshop.
 Paint Feature, mainly used to express the logic of solving puzzles through images.


After 8 months of development, these new features are halfway done, but they are still far away from completion. So we have to change the expected release date of the Update from end of 2024 to some time in 2025.

In addition, the price of the game has been adjusted from $4.99 to $0.99 for the US region, and the price for other regions has been adjusted accordingly. The purpose to give a friendlier price to players who are looking to purchase the game now. The plan is to increase the price slowly as time progresses and development progresses over the next 5 years.

In addition, plans for multiplayer features, Sudoku variants (such as Killer Sudoku), which were in the long-term development plan, have been cancelled. Languages except Chinese and English, are going to be removed. The main reason for these changes is to focus development time on single-player features over the next 2 years, which will bring more value to players who only need single-player features.

Below are the latest screenshot of the in-game Paint feature (in development and subject to change):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/086daea30baefc6903c954c70f9545fe0d03b202.jpg

Other new features are not finished yet, so we do not show screenshots of them for now. I'll go back to work now, see you when the update is ready!

notes.title: DevLog 6 We're working on a HUGE update!
notes.content:
5 months have passed since the last update for Rated Sudoku. Some of you might be worried that we have abandoned the game. However, the opposite is true, we are working very hard on a few HUGE features. They are so BIG, even though we have been working on them nonstop for 5 months, we still need a few more months to make them work seamlessly together and without issues.

What features will the next version have? Our plan is that the next version will have 4 new features.

[olist]
 Campaigns feature that uses text and images as well as exercise puzzles to help you learn Sudoku. Which includes an official campaign, and the ability for players to make their own campaigns and upload them to the Steam Workshop.
 Sudoku Paint feature. Draw Sudoku board, with numbers and candidates, coloring, and as well as lines and text. It's great when you need to explain your technique to others. The images can be embedded in campaigns.
 Sudoku Editor feature. Create your own puzzle and see the solution instantly as you enter the last number of the puzzle. With a single click, our game will eliminate unnecessary given numbers to give you a minimal puzzle(the minimum that is required for the puzzle to have a unique solution). This solver here can solve any classic Sudoku puzzle instantly.
 Sudoku Analyze feature. For most puzzles (including those you entered), our game will show you how to solve them step by step, what you can do at this step, and, what the rationale for doing so is, and what the name of the technique is. However, this feature can only solve Sudoku puzzles that can be solved by human techniques. If the puzzle can't be solved with human techniques, this feature won't help.
[/olist]

If everything goes smoothly, it is expected that this update can be released in this winter, and at that time, our game will be the most full-featured Sudoku game on Steam, so let's wait and see! I won't show screenshots of the new features in development here. I hope to give you a surprise when the new version comes out.

We've decided to postpone the development of the multiplayer feature, hopefully we will continue to work on that in 2025. For now, we're focusing on the single-player aspect of the game.

By the way, we decided to adjust the price from $7 to $5, because we want to make it available to as many people as possible.

We will disappear for the next few months in order to dedicate all our time 100% on the game. When we come out (to the real world) again, hopefully it will be when the update is released, with all the features described above. See you then!

Please add the game to your Wishlist if you are excited about these features. We believe you won't be disappointed with the next update! Let's wait for the winter together!

notes.title: Rated Sudoku Dev Log #5 Campaigns, Campaign Editor, Sudoku Paint in development
notes.content:
What I've been up to

It's been over 2 months since last Dev Log, I'm still working on the game in this period of time. I'm going to give you a bit information on recent plans and progress.

Because the two new major features I'm working on are difficult, the next version may be released in July 2024 at the earliest. If you want to purchase the game after these features come out, you can add the game to your wishlist now.

The first major feature I'm working on is Campaigns and Campaign Editor. Campaigns are basically small books that uses text, pictures and exercise puzzles to help you learn Sudoku and do related exercises.

In addition to writing one or more official Campaigns, I plan to provide a Campaign Editor. This will allow players to create custom campaigns and make them available to other players through the Steam Workshop.

The other major feature I'm working on is Sudoku Paint. As mentioned earlier, campaigns are like small books, and Sudoku books need a way to provide easy-to-understand pictures that contain explanations of Sudoku examples.

So, I am developing a Paint feature. It allows players to quickly draw Sudoku related pictures. These pictures will be able to be easily embedded in campaigns.

At present, the framework for Sudoku Paint is completed, and more painting tools will be added in the near future to help players to draw informative pictures.

The Campaign Editor is still in the early development stage, so no screenshots will be revealed for the time being. Only screenshots of the campaign gameplay and the primitive Sudoku Paint feature will be revealed below.

notes.title: Rated Sudoku Free Demo is OUT!
notes.content:
I know what you're thinking, you don't want risk buying this game if it is bad. So, I've released a free demo! If you are not satisfied with the demo, there is no reason to buy the full version. Also, the demo version will be updated simultaneously with the full version in the future. So you can wait until the demo is good enough and buy the game afterward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/589199f544055c70aa7a4ef82a8f2ec77f996ded.png
The following are the main differences between the demo and the full game:


 No achievements
 Cannot play rated games, and therefore no leaderboard
 You can't switch themes, music or scenes.


So what can you play in the demo?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/a8d541e05b61e829d5112cf7be477faddd0476e7.png

Custom games! You can enter your own puzzles, or randomly select puzzles by rating or clue count. The number of puzzles included is the same as in the full version, more than 2000.

Of course, there is also a match history, recent puzzles, and these features are the same as in the full version.

In addition, the campaign feature (that is, a few dozen levels each contain a puzzle), which is planned to be developed next, is also playable in the demo version, completely free of charge!

In other words, if the plan is executed well, we'll have a demo version afterward that's as good as other paid Sudoku game on steam!

It'll take a few months, though, as I need to develop a campaign editor and then design the levels, and, in particular, collect some of the more educational puzzles (which, of course, I won't design myself, I'll have to collect some free puzzles), which could take quite a bit of time.

Don't miss out, it's free!

notes.title: Rated Sudoku Devlog #3 A Version Worth Buying
notes.content:
Hello, dear gamers, it's been a month since the last devlog. During this month, I have been working hard on the game. Today, at the event of a major new version, I'm taking some time to talk to you about the game.

Since August 2023, I have been working on Rated Sudoku full time, it's been more than 6 months now. Because of the consistent hard work, the game is now the best Sudoku game on Steam in terms of features and content.

The best Sudoku game on Steam
In the last devlog, I compared this game with other Sudoku games and came to the conclusion that it has surpassed them. This time, let's do it again. Let's see how it turns out.

Rated Sudoku v0.6 and two other popular Sudoku games on Steam are compared below:

Notes for *:

Verdict
The previous v0.5 version of Rated Sudoku barely surpassed these other games in terms of features and content. And v0.6 of Rated Sudoku surpasses them across the board.

It is worth noting that Rated Sudoku has overcome the shortcomings present in v0.5 by supplementing the new version with number highlighting, conflict hints, and puzzle personal record features.

In conclusion, since these games are currently among the most popular Sudoku games on Steam, the v0.6 version of Rated Sudoku has fully surpassed them in terms of features and content. So, in my personal opinion, Rated Sudoku is the best Sudoku game on Steam, bar none, and deservedly so.

v0.6 Features
Let's talk about what exciting new features are in v0.6!

Number Highlighting

The game play UI has a new number highlighting, as well as a number counting feature. As you can see in the screenshot, clicking on the number 7 on the right makes it easy to see where all the 7s are, and also tells you how many 7s are left to fill in. This is very helpful in solving puzzles and can save a lot of time.

This is one of the key features that Rated Sudoku has added in this version, taking the best from other Sudoku games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/8f12b33ade6cc3542b33ce7853b051239503c4a3.png

Conflict Hint
Another important feature that has been added to the game play UI is the Conflict Hint.

In the process of solving puzzles, sometimes you will fill in wrong numbers, but you don't know it. The Conflict Hint feature can tell you that the number filled in this position conflicts with numbers in the same row, column or block.

You can avoid making more mistakes after that, and you can finish the puzzle faster by correcting the mistakes in time.

As you can see in the screenshot, the 2 in the selected position conflicts with the 2 in the same row and block, and is indicated by a circle and a sound effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/bc77d4c4a87e7a10ecb7e82185480fca539b2656.png

Again, this is one of the key features that Rated Sudoku has added in this version, taking the best from other Sudoku games.

Match History
The big feature in this version is Match History. As far as I know, this feature is not available in any other Sudoku game on Steam.

Why do you need this feature?

Firstly, it can be used to see which puzzles you have recently failed to solve, so that you can try them again and improve your skills.

Secondly, you can use it to see your win rate for a specific puzzle, your best time to solve it, and you can try to break your own record.

Thirdly, you can use the Share feature to show off your personal record for a puzzle with your Steam friends.

As shown in the screenshot, you can view the most recently played matches and their details:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/0d4a09f66a288f09c1ba81a47d49981cbd02d0da.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/1546f601e7c09e24a93eaa874e3fa1420b96e3e6.png

You can also view recently played puzzles and their details:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/5909d3757d93f0c58f5e89fd67e80f4d2bca7dbe.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/a789a2c3680bdb6d988861c75acedb4356574c31.png

Then, you can also send your Steam friends a message about your personal record for a specific puzzle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/5cf22367ed2181d516baa3d869c53ffc2d3c7ddf.png

Themes
It is important to have all important features, it is also important to keep the game aesthetically pleasing. In order to satisfy the tastes of different players, so, I have developed the Themes feature.

In this version, Rated Sudoku offers 3 themes. You can switch between them in the Settings screen. As shown in the screenshots, this is how the same board looks like on different themes. The first theme, is Classic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/f5dc369c19240932648ed8011464d5831788a3c4.png

The second theme is Ancient One.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/0b42330215b250dfe7c4aa56c6c88997d06adb31.png

The third theme is Zen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/d22f115ac4a46f3c1e55523a10a8a0b10a4baa8e.png

If you don't like any of these, no problem, you can recommend me your favorite theme with screenshots or psd documents! If it's good I'll consider adding it to the game!

Also, more themes will be coming in future versions.

5 new languages
I've added 5 new languages in this version. It's safe to say that, in this way, the game has covered all major languages on Steam.

I don't know any of the languages except for English and Chinese, so there may be quite a few errors in the translations. If you find that the translations in any of these languages are not good enough, you can contact me and I will send you the text so that you can contribute to the translations of this game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/754ff720e6501cd31f8f0d75b1bb1d93aa1c8f9b.jpg

Why v0.6 is worth buying
First, I'd like to announce a price change. Only the USD price is mentioned here, prices in other currencies change accordingly. The previous price was $3, but now it's changed to $10, which is more expensive than most other Sudoku games (usually $5). Why is the price so high?

This is because Rated Sudoku v0.6 has most features that popular Sudoku games have, and also features that popular Sudoku games don't have, and these unique features are valuable to players, which is why it is more expensive than other Sudoku games.

v0.6 is a good enough for people who only need the Single Player experience, as Single Player is feature complete. Here is a highlight of why this version is worth getting.

Uniqueness 1: Custom Game
Other popular Sudoku games on Steam, in general, only allow you to play puzzles provided by the developer, as well as generated puzzles, and not input your own puzzles.

If you see an interesting puzzle in a book, article, or video, you can't play it in those games. In Rated Sudoku, you just need to enter the puzzle and go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/7fb3627ffe716edd95128fcf7956d6269b40aa75.png

Uniqueness 2: Rating and Leaderboard
With other popular Sudoku games on Steam, there is no way for you to know how well you're playing and whether you're good or not relative to other players.

For many Sudoku fans, it is important to know if you are outperforming other players.

Rated Sudoku gives Sudoku puzzles a rating according to difficulty. Then, depending on whether you can successfully solve the puzzle or not, your rating increase or decrease accordingly.

This way, you'll have a rating that represents your skill, and in the Leaderboard, you'll be able to compare yourself to other players and learn how well you're playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/a41b862b5c319d700c447cfa2f264697a8b8952f.png

Uniqueness 3: 2699 puzzles
Compared to hundreds of puzzles in other Sudoku games on Steam, Rated Sudoku features a whopping 2,699 puzzles.

And not just any puzzle will be included, either. Those 2,699 puzzles have an even distribution of difficulty, as well as a even distribution of clue count. There are plenty of puzzles to choose from for whatever difficulty and clue count you want to play (within a reasonable range).

And, this game has quite a few 17 clue and 18 clue puzzles, which, as of now, are not included in other popular Sudoku games on Steam.

These puzzles are challenging and, I think, are of interest to any hardcore Sudoku fans. Here is one of the 17 clue puzzles, doesn't it look difficult?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/89087928bebc8e9fa757a9620104c684f94abbb5.png

Unique Feature #4: Match History Feature
This is a feature that no other Sudoku game on Steam has, as far as I know.

See your recent victories and defeats as well as the personal record of recently played puzzles. It's handy for solving puzzles you couldn't solve before, or beating your previous personal record. You can also share your personal records with your Steam friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/0d4a09f66a288f09c1ba81a47d49981cbd02d0da.png

Uniqueness 5: Themes

About Me
Hello everyone, I am Ace Zhu. Ace Zhu is my game development name, not my real name. I'll keep my real name a secret for now, but I'll announce it after I've had success with a few games. Because if none of my games are successful, it's too embarrassing to say I made them, right?

I've been involved in indie game development full-time since 2017, so I've been doing indie game development for a full 7 years now, and the specialty I've been responsible for has always been programming. Basically, I didn't have a "real job" in those years, I've been making games with like-minded people. Although I think my programming skills are quite good, from the beginning, and even more so now, but, in terms of the outcome, the projects I have participated in have not been successful.

There are a total of 4 indie game projects that I've been involved in before, and they were all different teams, and since none of those games were successful, I won't mention their names, and in any case, most of them are still on Steam.

The previous failures, I don't know, were because they were bad ideas, or I was a bad programmer, in any case, there hasn't been a single successful game yet.

I don't want this to continue any more, after all it's been 7 years, I needed a change. So, I started Rated Sudoku, an attempt to make a breakthrough. Because I don't know if the previous failures were because I was a bad programmer, or if the games were bad ideas. So, why not, just do it solo with a good idea this time, so that if the game fails, I'll know that it was me all along. If that turns out to be the case, maybe I should just go home and work for my dad. Hahahahaha ːsteamhappyː

Honestly though, even though it's been 2 months since the Early Access release of Rated Sudoku and it hasn't even sold 50 copies, the quality of the game in it's current version is something I'm proud of. With another year of improvements and refinements, it might reach the level of quality of a classic game. Even if it doesn't sell 1000 copies in the end, I'll still be proud of myself.

GL HF

v0.5.0 and v0.5.1 Patch Notes
I'm very happy to announce that versions 0.5.0, and 0.5.1 have been released. Among them, v0.5.1 fixes several bugs of v0.5.0. I summarize the improvements of both versions below:

 New feature: Custom game

Comparison with other Sudoku games

Notes for *:

Competitor A has 225 puzzles as of now, but it also has an infinite mode, which means randomly generated puzzles as needed, except that the quality of the randomly generated puzzles on demand is not as good as the quality of the puzzles prepared in advance
I don't know if Competitor B has 17 and 18 clue puzzles, this is because I didn't play to the end and don't know the content of the later puzzles
Keyboard only input means only using the keyboard and not the mouse when solving puzzles
Competitor A has achievements, but the meaning of them are confusing


Overall Result
Rated Sudoku is still in Early Access, but it has already surpassed other popular Sudoku games in terms of features and content.

The only two areas where Rated Sudoku is currently inferior to these games are the absence of the following features:

 Number highlighting, highlighting 1, 2, etc.
 Puzzle personal record, the shortest time a particular puzzle is solved


However, because there are more puzzles, features such as Custom Game, Leaderboard, etc., it has surpassed them overall.

Highlight 1: Pencilmarks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/879c6eb0afe7a1a885d176684796770cedd329d3.jpg

As shown in the screenshot, Rated Sudoku has Pencilmarks (small numbers) feature so that you don't need to rely on memory. It works very well.

Puzzles except easy ones will have slots with only 2-3 possibilities, but can't be decided for a while, and using pencilmarks to record them will make it much easier to solve.

This feature is also available in some other Sudoku games, but not in all of them.

Highlight 2: Custom Game
This version has one new feature, Custom Game. With Custom Games, you can play any puzzle! Just enter the puzzle into Rated Sudoku.

For example, if you see an interesting Sudoku puzzle on a website, you can enter it directly into Rated Sudoku to play it, as shown here:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/25358c66de65ccedf6a993b02515bc98132d0488.jpg

Type in the puzzle content, click Check to find out if the puzzle is valid (i.e. if there is one and only one solution) and what its difficulty is, and then you can start solving the puzzle! It's that simple!

This feature is not available in most other Sudoku games.

Highlight 3: Great Keyboard and Mouse Input
Rated Sudoku has well designed keyboard and mouse input. You can play in a few ways, whichever suits you best:

[olist]
 Mouse click to select a slot, keyboard to enter numbers from regular number keys, hold shift to toggle pencilmarks
 Mouse click to select a slot, keyboard to enter numbers from Numpad, hold shift to toggle pencilmarks
 Arrows keys to select a slot, keyboard to enter numbers from regular number keys, hold shift to toggle pencilmarks
 WSAD to select a slot, keyboard to enter numbers from Numpad, hold shift to toggle pencilmarks
[/olist]

The following keys are currently used:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/69cb050144739fb39601d60ed49e8d15cf3bdcbc.jpg

This will allow you to solve puzzles with ease! More improvements on input is planned, such as (planned, subject to change):
1. Holding Ctrl + arrow keys to move fast (move a few slots at once)
2. Adding XBox controller input support

Some other Sudoku games do not support keyboard input, and while others do support it, they are not as well-designed as Rated Sudoku.

Highlight 4: Leaderboards
Compare with players from around the world! This version improved this screen, and it looks better now! As you can see in the screenshot (this is my rank, the reason why I'm ranked 4th is because there are not many players at the moment):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768463/dc94b9fe8f0c2a6ae4714e1d3329ccd35d0898af.jpg

Most other Sudoku games do not have a Leaderboard feature.

My personal experience as a Sudoku player
I'm quite new to Sudoku, I have just started playing a few months ago, and I only know 3 techniques, and I don't even their names. I've learned them through trial and error. But so far, it seems that the easy and medium difficulty puzzles are doable, although they might take half an hour. I haven't tried the hard puzzles, so I don't know yet.

Anyway, I'll be playing Sudoku in Rated Sudoku for a long time to come, and learning and growing into an advanced Sudoku player(hopefully). Finding out what features I need and develop them for myself! So I can make sure that this game will satisfy the needs of the majority of Sudoku players!

Developer's Note
As a developer, I am proud that Rated Sudoku has surpassed other Sudoku games on Steam in terms of features and content.

In addition, Rated Sudoku is still in Early Access, which means that I will be working on and releasing many new features and improvements in the process. Hopefully, one day, Rated Sudoku will far surpass other Sudoku games on Steam and become the choice of the majority of Sudoku players.

There are lots of new features, puzzles and other improvements planned for Rated Sudoku in 2024, so follow and add the game to your wish list please!
